about: Logical dependencies between dismissal facts that rules.json does not encode but a coherent file must respect (the employment relationship ends when the notice period ends). Read by generator/design.py; each adjustment is logged in the design (constraint_adjustments).

constraints.note: if the notice period has not ended (or that is open), more than 180 days since the end of employment cannot be stated
if the notice period has not ended (or that is open), a claim made pending within 180 days of the end of employment cannot be stated either way
